draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.62, the 253rd-best grade among 259 2023 draftees and 35th of 36 at CB. He went 258th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 2 passes defended in 2022, 35th of 36 CBs in his class with stats.
